blocks.title: Rebalancing Malé towards urban life
blocks.text: Relocating the port to Thilafushi moves Malé up the value chain, from back-of-house operations to a front-of-house city.

blocks.heading: MOVING UP THE VALUE CHAIN
blocks.alt: Diagram: BACK OF HOUSE; port, cargo, warehouses; FRONT OF HOUSE; arrival, markets, public life.

cards.title: where people meet at ground level
cards.text: Shaded streets, active edges and car-free superblocks bring life back to the ground floor.

cards.title: affordable to those who live here
cards.text: Social housing, rehousing in place and a mix of home sizes keep Malé’s own people in Malé.

cards.title: that gives back to nature
cards.text: Breeze corridors, green roofs and a restored coastline return space to sea, wind and shade.

figures.label: Figure
figures.text: A shaded walk by the water.

items.note: a third fewer: homes get more room

blocks.text: Site metrics, and capstone housing, existing and proposed. Open area includes pedestrian streets. A home averages 55,000 sq ft ÷ 80 homes; living area is 55,000 sq ft ÷ 244 people.
